name: Reu
overview: Reu is presented in Scripture as a key figure in the genealogical line leading to Abraham, identified as the son of Peleg. The Genesis account details Reu's lifespan, noting he lived thirty-two years before fathering Serug and continued to live for two hundred seven years thereafter, highlighting the long lifespans characteristic of early biblical patriarchs. The genealogical record in 1 Chronicles 1:25 further confirms Reu's place within the lineage descending from Eber through Peleg. These passages emphasize Reu's role in God's providential unfolding of the covenantal promises through Abraham's ancestry.
